Hero.title: Your story, inked forever.
Hero.subtitle: A Berlin studio for tattoos made with intention — bold blackwork, fine detail, and everything in between.

Studio.heading: A space built around your story.
Studio.body: Ink Studio is a space for people who see a tattoo not just as an image, but as part of their own story. Artists of different styles work under one roof, with the same attention to detail in every session — and in the conversation that happens before the needle ever touches skin.
Studio.statsDisclaimer: Illustrative figures for this concept project — not a claim about a real business.

individualDesign.title: Individual Design
individualDesign.description: An individual approach to every piece.

experiencedArtists.title: Experienced Artists
experiencedArtists.description: Artists with different styles and specializations.

alex.description: Bold linework and graphic composition — tattoos that read like poster art.
alex.bio: Alex works in heavy blackwork and graphic shapes, building tattoos the way a poster designer builds a layout — strong silhouettes first, detail second. Best known for large-scale pieces that hold up from across the room.

mia.description: Delicate linework for pieces that whisper rather than shout.
mia.bio: Mia's fine-line and minimal work is about restraint — thin, confident lines and a lot of empty space. A favourite for first tattoos and quiet, personal pieces.

noah.description: Photographic detail and rich color, built up session by session.
noah.bio: Noah specializes in color realism — portraits, animals, nature — built up in careful layers over multiple sessions. Technical precision with a painter's eye for color.

eva.description: Bold outlines and saturated color with a modern illustrative twist.
eva.bio: Eva reinterprets traditional tattoo motifs with a modern illustrative style — bold outlines, saturated color, and a bit of storytelling in every piece.

shadow-wolf.description: A heavy blackwork wolf built from solid negative space.

botanical-line.description: Single-needle botanical study, kept light and airy.

portrait-study.description: Color realism portrait, built up over three sessions.

phoenix-rising.description: Saturated neo-traditional phoenix with bold outlines.

geometric-stag.description: A stag reduced to clean geometric blackwork shapes.

single-line-wave.description: A minimal wave rendered in a single continuous line.

koi-in-color.description: Layered color work capturing movement in the water.

traditional-rose.description: A rose in saturated traditional color and bold linework.

linework-portrait.description: A portrait built entirely from fine, deliberate lines.

realistic-lion.description: Black-and-grey realism with careful shading and depth.

minimal-mountain.description: A quiet mountain range reduced to its simplest form.

blackwork-mandala.description: A large-scale mandala built from precise blackwork patterns.

tattoo.name: Tattoo
tattoo.description: Custom tattoos across styles — blackwork, fine line, realism, color, and neo-traditional. Price and duration depend on size and detail and are confirmed during your consultation.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.description: Professional piercing with sterile, single-use equipment and clear aftercare guidance.

consultation.name: Consultation
consultation.description: A free sit-down to talk placement, size, and style before booking a session — no commitment required.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.body: Ink Studio is a demo/concept project built for a developer portfolio. It is not a real business, and this page does not describe the practices of an actual company. In a production deployment, this page would explain what data is collected through the booking form, how it is stored (via Supabase), and how visitors can request its removal.
